harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Nginx is installed, enabled at boot, and serving HTTP successfully on TCP 6700 across all four nodes. Each node was restarted sequentially; every boot ID changed and all services, content, listeners, and required firewall settings recovered.
actions_performed: Installed Nginx using DNF on AlmaLinux nodes and APK on Alpine nodes.
Configured node-specific web content and Nginx listeners on IPv4 and IPv6 TCP 6700.
Added persistent SELinux http_port_t mappings and firewalld access for TCP 6700 on node1 and node2.
Enabled Nginx through systemd on AlmaLinux and OpenRC on Alpine.
Restarted node1, node2, node3, and node4 individually and verified recovery after each restart.
Ran a final cross-node HTTP check that returned status 200 from every node.

evidence.requirement: All four nodes serve HTTP successfully on TCP 6700
evidence.summary: Direct listener and HTTP checks succeeded on every node; the final post-restart cross-node matrix returned HTTP 200 and the correct node-specific page from all four managed IPs.

evidence.requirement: AlmaLinux SELinux and firewall configuration permits persistent TCP 6700 service
evidence.summary: TCP 6700 is labeled http_port_t, Nginx is enabled and active, and firewalld reports the port allowed in both runtime and permanent configuration on node1 and node2.
